claim: 76% of shoppers say high-quality product images are extremely or very important to their decision to click on a product page from search results.
45% of shoppers returned an item in the past year because of incorrect product content, such as images that didn't match the product.
Placing a product in a lifestyle context in a mobile Sponsored Brands ad can deliver click-through rates 40% higher than ads with standard product images.
source: Amazon, Amazon rolls out AI-powered image generation to help advertisers

claim: Amazon product detail pages that added their first shoppable video saw an average 24% increase in sales compared with those without videos.
source: Amazon, Let Amazon product videos show customers what images can't

claim: Basic A+ Content (enhanced images and comparison charts) can increase Amazon sales by up to 8%, and well-implemented Premium A+ Content by up to 20%.
According to Shopify merchant data, products with AR and 3D content see conversion rates up to 94% higher than comparable products without them.
source: Shopify, 6 Digital Transformation Trends in Retail

claim: 56% of users' first action on a product page is to explore the product images, before reading titles or descriptions.
source: Baymard Institute, Ensure Sufficient Image Resolution and Zoom

claim: 42% of users try to gauge product size from images, yet 37% of sites provide no 'in scale' image.
80% of surveyed users of Google's AI-powered Product Studio have been, or expect to be, more efficient creating product images and videos.
source: Google Merchant Center Help, About Product Studio

claim: On 73% of mobile web pages the Largest Contentful Paint element is an image, so image delivery largely decides how fast a mobile page feels.
